home.about: A bright, open home on a corner lot in the Harvest community of Argyle. Three bedrooms are on the main level, with a bonus loft upstairs for a game room, office or second living space. The community pool, trails and Argyle West Elementary are close by.

neighborhood.community: Harvest is a master-planned community built around the outdoors. Spend the morning at the resort-style pool or the fitness barn, then walk the 11-acre lake or the 1.5-mile linear park. Saturdays bring the farmers market and community gardens, and neighbors gather all year. Argyle West Elementary is about 0.4 mi away.
